work.scenario: During a project meeting, your team discusses the upcoming launch of a new feature. There's a minor bug that needs to be fixed before release, and everyone needs to update their development environment.
key_phrases: Kita perlu melancarkan ciri baru ini minggu depan.
Pasukan IT sedang cuba menyelesaikan masalah rangkaian.
Sila mengemas kini perisian anda sebelum mesyuarat esok.

life.scenario: You're chatting with a friend about a popular new mobile app. Your friend mentions that a video about the app went viral, but you find the app not very user-friendly.
key_phrases: Video tutorial aplikasi itu dah viral dekat TikTok.
Saya rasa aplikasi ni tak berapa mesra pengguna.
Telefon saya selalu minta update sistem operasi.

tech.scenario: A company is undergoing a major digital transformation. The challenge is to upgrade their legacy systems and ensure the new platforms are intuitive for all employees, especially older staff.
key_phrases: Projek transformasi digital syarikat memerlukan banyak sumber.
Kita perlu menaik taraf infrastruktur pelayan kita.
Pastikan reka bentuk antara muka itu intuitif dan mudah digunakan.
